svg.title: The clock driver's own ground bounce
svg.desc: A CDC329A in the middle of the backplane drives six slots (0 to 2 and 13 to 15) through 68 ohm, all six outputs falling together, fast corner, with the IBIS file's supply currents raw and calibrated. Left: the clock at slot 0's ABT244. Right: the driver's die ground.
svg.text: ns from the input crossing 1.5 V
